cautions: Nontrivial holonomy is not itself a proof of dynamical protection, localization or mass.
The native memory charge, geometric winding and electric charge are different labels; their proposed maps are explicit obligations.
The −1 winding companion is not an identified antiparticle. Negative Nambu rows are not extra particle species.
Position and momentum have probability distributions; a sharp result in one setting does not erase the other distribution.
Consensus compares record descriptions; it does not select a Born outcome by agreement.
Finite operation counts do not alone determine a Hamiltonian or a physical mass.
The homogeneous free Dirac action is distinct from the fixed compact texture operator.
